description: Use this when the person asks what a call would cost, or before running a paid tool. Send the tool name and its arguments. Returns the price, whether today's free calls cover it, the wallet balance, how much this key can still spend without asking, and a quote_id that holds the price for 30 minutes. Pass quote_id with the call to pay the quoted price.

arguments.description: The arguments you plan to send with it.

tool.description: The tool you plan to call, e.g. get_pre_brief.

name: quote
title: Get the price of a call
